questions.prompt: What is the biggest difference between school and college?
The deck says most missed work doesn't punish you that week — it punishes you…
questions.explanation: The deck calls this 'the long fuse' — consequences land a couple of months later.

questions.prompt: What does the "Long Fuse" idea mean?
The deck says confidence isn't a personality trait — it's what you build by…
options: Doing things you weren't sure you could
Being told you're good at it
questions.explanation: Confidence is what you build by doing things you weren't sure you could.

questions.prompt: Which of these are 'real barriers' to attendance named in the deck? Select all that apply.
options: Mental health — anxiety, low mood, sleep that doesn't come
Money and travel — when bus fares add up
Things at home — caring responsibilities, family pressure, unsafe situations
Being in the wrong friendship group at break
questions.explanation: Mental health, money & travel, and things at home are three of the five named barriers. (Neurodivergence / chronic health and friendships/fitting in are also listed.)

questions.prompt: Which phrase from the deck captures the key line on barriers?
options: 'Tough it out — that's what college is.'
'A barrier we know about is one we can help with.'
'Attendance is the only measure that matters.'
'If you're struggling, you should switch course.'
questions.explanation: 'A barrier we know about is one we can help with. A barrier we don't know about is one that quietly takes you out.'
